decisions.decision: Bypass Android MtpDevice lockout by relying on native PTP streaming (0x1008 ObjectInfo & 0x1009 GetObject)
decisions.rationale: Reverse engineering Piufoto confirmed that claiming USB interfaces locks Android MtpDevice.open(); native PTP adapters ensure plug-and-play across brands.

decisions.decision: Preserve job.originalFileName 1:1 without stripping numeric prefixes
decisions.rationale: Prevents camera filenames like 100_0001.JPG and 0001_0002.CR3 from being mangled on Google Drive and NAS.
